review: 718.3a-1: variant seven_plains changed two facts against the base (land count and land type); dropped it, the base, two_mountains and three_plains variants already show castability judged by the alternative cost only.

skipped.reason: the alternative values being part of copiable values shows only when a copy is a prototyped spell or permanent, which scenarios 718.3c-1 and 718.3d-1 cover; a copy of a normally cast permanent has the normal characteristics and shows nothing further

scenarios.title: A prototyped spell is judged for casting by its alternative mana cost only

setup.notes: Blitz Automaton: normal mana cost {7}, 6/4; prototype {2}{R}, 3/2.

decisions: A checks whether Blitz Automaton can be cast as a prototyped spell (cost {2}{R}) and whether it can be cast normally (cost {7}).

variants.label: three_mountains
variants.expected: Casting as a prototyped spell is legal, with cost {2}{R}. Casting normally is not legal (cost {7}, only 3 mana available).

variants.label: two_mountains
variants.delta: A controls two Mountains instead of three.
variants.expected: Neither is legal: {2}{R} and {7} both exceed the available mana.

variants.label: three_plains
variants.delta: A controls three Plains instead of three Mountains.
variants.expected: Neither is legal: {2}{R} cannot be paid without red mana, and {7} exceeds the available mana.

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: three Mountains are each replaced by a Plains

detector.outcome: A candidate produced by a Prototype keyword (casting a spell for its prototype cost) is legal when that cost can be paid.
detector.near_miss: A Prototype candidate the verdict marks not playable because its cost cannot be paid.

scenarios.title: A prototyped permanent has the alternative power, toughness, mana cost and color; cast normally it has the normal ones

setup.notes: Blitz Automaton: normal mana cost {7}, colorless 6/4; prototype {2}{R}, 3/2.

decisions: A casts Blitz Automaton as a prototyped spell, paying {2}{R} with three Mountains.
Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: prototyped
variants.expected: Blitz Automaton on the battlefield is a red 3/2 artifact creature with mana value 3 and haste.

variants.label: cast_normally
variants.delta: A casts Blitz Automaton normally, paying {7} with all seven Mountains.
variants.expected: Blitz Automaton on the battlefield is a colorless 6/4 artifact creature with mana value 7 and haste.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: the card is cast normally instead of prototyped

scenarios.title: A prototyped spell on the stack has the colors of its alternative mana cost

setup.notes: Hydroblast mode: counter target spell if it's red.

decisions: A casts Blitz Automaton as a prototyped spell, paying {2}{R} with three Mountains.
A passes priority.
B casts Hydroblast in response, choosing the counter mode and targeting Blitz Automaton, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Hydroblast resolves.
If Blitz Automaton is still on the stack, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: prototyped_red
variants.expected: Blitz Automaton is a red spell: Hydroblast counters it and it goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: cast_normally_colorless
variants.delta: A casts Blitz Automaton normally, paying {7} with all seven Mountains.
variants.expected: Blitz Automaton is a colorless spell: Hydroblast resolves and does nothing. Blitz Automaton then resolves and a 6/4 enters the battlefield.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: the card is cast normally instead of prototyped

detector.outcome: A spell is countered by a resolution whose condition reads the spell's characteristics.
detector.near_miss: A Counter resolution that countered nothing.

scenarios.title: A copy of a prototyped spell is itself a prototyped spell
decisions: A casts Blitz Automaton as a prototyped spell, paying {2}{R} with three Mountains.
A casts Double Major in response, paying {G}{U}, targeting the Blitz Automaton spell.
Both players pass; Double Major resolves and copies the spell.
Both players pass; the copy resolves, then both players pass and the original resolves.

variants.label: prototyped
variants.expected: A controls two permanents: the original and a token copy. Both are red 3/2 artifact creatures with mana value 3.

variants.label: cast_normally
variants.delta: A casts Blitz Automaton normally, paying {7} with the seven Mountains.
variants.expected: A controls two permanents: the original and a token copy. Both are colorless 6/4 artifact creatures with mana value 7.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: the card is cast normally instead of prototyped

scenarios.forge_notes: Double Major copies the creature spell; the copy becomes a token on resolution.

detector.outcome: A copy-spell resolution holds a spell_copied event.
detector.near_miss: A CopySpellAbility resolution that produced no copy.

scenarios.title: A copy of a permanent that was a prototyped spell has the alternative characteristics
decisions: A casts Blitz Automaton as a prototyped spell, paying {2}{R} with three Mountains.
Both players pass; it resolves.
A casts Clone, paying {3}{U} with four Islands.
Both players pass; Clone resolves and A has it enter as a copy of Blitz Automaton.

variants.label: prototyped_original
variants.expected: The Clone is a red 3/2 artifact creature Construct with mana value 3 and haste, like the original.

variants.label: normal_original
variants.delta: A casts Blitz Automaton normally, paying {7} with all seven Mountains.
variants.expected: The Clone is a colorless 6/4 artifact creature Construct with mana value 7 and haste, like the original.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: the card is cast normally instead of prototyped

scenarios.forge_notes: Whether Forge's Clone copies the prototype state of the permanent is to be checked.

scenarios.title: A prototype card in a zone other than the stack or battlefield has only its normal characteristics

setup.notes: Blitz Automaton died earlier as a prototyped permanent. Unearth: return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

decisions: A attempts to cast Unearth, targeting the creature card in A's graveyard.

variants.label: prototype_card_in_graveyard
variants.expected: Blitz Automaton has mana value 7 in the graveyard: Unearth has no legal target and cannot be cast.

variants.label: ordinary_creature_in_graveyard
variants.delta: The creature card in A's graveyard is Grizzly Bears (mana value 2) instead of Blitz Automaton.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a legal target: Unearth can be cast and returns it to the battlefield.

detector.outcome: A candidate that targets a card in a graveyard has no legal target because the card's characteristics there fail the targeting condition.
detector.near_miss: A candidate whose targeting clause has a legal target.

scenarios.title: A prototyped permanent keeps every characteristic other than power, toughness, mana cost and color

setup.notes: Combat Thresher: normal mana cost {7}, colorless 3/3; prototype {2}{W}, 1/1. Double strike; when it enters, draw a card.

decisions: A casts Combat Thresher as a prototyped spell, paying {2}{W} with three Plains.
Both players pass; it resolves.
Its enters trigger resolves.

variants.label: prototyped
variants.expected: Combat Thresher is a white 1/1 artifact creature Construct with double strike. A drew one card.

variants.label: cast_normally
variants.delta: A casts Combat Thresher normally, paying {7} with all seven Plains.
variants.expected: Combat Thresher is a colorless 3/3 artifact creature Construct with double strike. A drew one card: types, keyword and trigger match the prototyped case.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: the card is cast normally instead of prototyped
